# Bundled Amazon scraper runtime

Source: https://github.com/omkarcloud/amazon-scraper

Commit: `6697201f4a577a904a1a4836240901d7394e0ac4`.

Archive includes unmodified runtime Python source, README, requirements and MIT LICENSE (Copyright 2026 Chetan Jain). Upstream tests, fixtures and promotional images are excluded. The installer verifies SHA-256 before extraction. No account information or scraped page cache is included. Python dependencies still require installation from PyPI.
